system.description:
Hand-sized intelligent ruby housing a fragment of the Archaian mage Koweewah (AL N, INT 9, Ego/Psyche 11, Willpower 20; communicates in Ancient Archaian with Magic-Users, Illusionists, Clerics, or Druids).

  • Powers: Functions as a Gem of True Seeing, Medallion of Thoughts (60'), and Wand of Wonder, and detects gemstones within 30'.
  • Tutor: Can teach Ancient Archaian and—to a 5th-level+ Magic-User or Illusionist—the rules of Archomancy (instant on a successful INT check, or 4–8 weeks of study).
